item.title: REF 0.13.0
item.description:
• Band solo: hear just one band (Sub, Bass, Low mids … or your own) in both your mix and the reference. ⌥-click the Tone chart or the live spectrum for a Spot band you can sweep. B toggles it, [ and ] step through the bands. Shape, slope and more are in Settings › Listening.
  • Left and Right listening buttons, next to Mono and Side.
  • Match EQ: the Tone tab now opens with the EQ curve your master needs to land on the reference, plus a printout of every move (type, Hz, dB, Q, note) and Copy EQ. Surgical by default; Detailed and Broad are in Settings.
  • Reference slots (Settings › Comparing): keep up to 16 references and switch with a click or the number keys. Still one song on screen at a time.
  • Archive References: copy your references into one folder to move machines or send to someone; open it again with Open Archive.
  • PSR now has a name (Crushed to Very dynamic), and you can pick a PSR target to draw on PSR over time.
  • Note names under the pointer on the frequency charts (63 Hz · B1).
  • Balance by band in the Stereo tab and on the live Stereo meter, with a note when one band leans to one side.
  • Plug-in: the reference can follow your DAW (Settings › Plug-in › Reference plays), lined up by bars, with Set to playhead and Line up drops.
  • Plug-in: closing its window now turns Mono, Side, L/R, Fix and band solo off, so your master is never left in mono out of sight (a setting keeps them on).
